info.title: Confidential Inference Public Gateway API
info.description: This contract defines the real public API of the Rust gateway in services/gateway. The gateway sits behind the c8s tls-lb, which terminates public TLS inside the TEE and forwards HTTP to the gateway process. `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions` are OpenAI-compatible: request and response bodies follow the OpenAI chat-completions and legacy-completions shapes. The gateway itself validates only the `model` field on inference requests (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `proxy_inference`); it forwards the rest of the body to the upstream sglang-router unchanged. Bearer tokens authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>` (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `authenticate`). Every response carries an `X-Request-ID` header (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `request_id`); a caller may supply this header on the request, and the gateway echoes a valid value back or generates one.

servers.description: The c8s tls-lb public entry point

x-deployment-contract.tlsRequirement: c8s tls-lb terminates public TLS inside the TEE and sends plain HTTP to the gateway process over the cluster network (services/gateway/src/main.rs, GATEWAY_LISTEN 0.0.0.0:9443).
x-deployment-contract.inferenceUpstream: The gateway proxies /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions to the c8s workload-proxy loopback at http://127.0.0.1:30001, which forwards to the sglang-router workload (services/gateway/src/main.rs, INFERENCE_UPSTREAM_URL).

x-protection-limits.note: These are the deployed defaults. Each value is also a configurable environment variable, listed in parentheses.

tags.name: attestation
tags.description: Nonce-bound c8s evidence, produced by the gateway process.

tags.name: tls-lb-static
tags.description: Paths that the c8s tls-lb nginx process serves directly. Nginx never forwards these to the gateway process.

get.summary: Report that the gateway process runs
get.description: This route makes no upstream call and no availability check (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `health`).

get.summary: Report whether the gateway can serve inference
get.description: When the gateway state store failed to open, the gateway runs in outage-only mode and reports 503 without calling the upstream. Otherwise the gateway calls the upstream `/health` route and reports the result (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `ready`).

503.description: Either the gateway runs in outage-only mode (`status: outage_only`), or the upstream health check failed (`status: not_ready`).

get.description: The gateway lists the model accepted for inference. During an outage the gateway returns an empty `data` array with status 200. This route requires no bearer token.

200.description: The model catalog. `data` is empty when the gateway is unavailable for inference.

post.description: This route accepts an OpenAI chat-completions request and proxies it to the sglang-router upstream (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `chat_completions` calls `proxy_inference`). The gateway itself checks only that the body is valid JSON and that `model` names one authorized model. It does not validate `messages`; the upstream sglang service performs OpenAI request validation. Set `stream: true` for a `text/event-stream` response.

200.description: The non-streaming response is one JSON chat-completion object. The streaming response is a `text/event-stream` of `chat.completion.chunk` events, ending with a literal `data: [DONE]` event.

post.description: This is the legacy (non-chat) OpenAI-compatible completions route. It shares the same gateway-side validation, proxy path, and error behavior as `/v1/chat/completions` (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `completions` calls `proxy_inference`).

200.description: The non-streaming response is one JSON text-completion object. The streaming response is a `text/event-stream`, ending with a literal `data: [DONE]` event.

get.description: Same handler and behavior as `/v1/attestation` (services/gateway/src/lib.rs routes both paths to `attestation_response`).

The caller supplies one fresh, canonical, unpadded base64url-encoded 32-byte nonce, either as the `nonce` query parameter or as the `X-Attestation-Nonce` header, never both (services/gateway/ATTESTATION.md; services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `attestation_response`). The response carries raw evidence for independent, offline verification with `scripts/verify-public-attestation.py`. It proves launch or admission only; see contracts/workload-attestation.schema.json for the full response shape.

get.summary: Read the static c8s discovery document
get.description: Nginx aliases this path directly to a local file. The gateway process never sees this request. The response is the discovery document that services/gateway/ATTESTATION.md describes as the c8s TLS-LB front door (`GATEWAY_C8S_EVIDENCE_BASE_URL` reads this same document from the internal side).

200.description: The c8s discovery document. Nginx sets `Cache-Control: no-store` and serves it from the local filesystem, not from the gateway.

get.description: Nginx aliases this path directly to a local PEM file. The gateway process never sees this request.

get.summary: Read the runtime mesh CA certificate
get.description: Nginx aliases this path directly to a local PEM file. The gateway process never sees this request.

get.summary: Read a c8s well-known evidence route
get.description: Nginx proxies every `/.well-known/c8s/*` path straight to the internal c8s evidence service on port 8800. It never forwards these to the gateway process. `/.well-known/c8s/attest-lb` is the front-door TLS receipt that services/gateway/ATTESTATION.md describes.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The remaining c8s well-known path segment, for example `attest-lb`.

200.description: The c8s evidence service response for this well-known path.

get.description: Nginx proxies this path straight to the internal c8s evidence service on port 8801. It never forwards these to the gateway process.
Nginx proxies this path to the internal c8s evidence service on port 8800. This is not the gateway's own `/ready` route.

200.description: The c8s evidence service is ready.

get.description: Nginx answers this route locally with a fixed `ok` body. This is not the gateway's own `/health` route.

bearerAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`. The gateway rejects a missing header, a missing `Bearer ` prefix, an empty token, and a token over 256 bytes, all with the same `invalid_api_key` error, to avoid revealing which check failed (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `authenticate`).

AttestationNonceQuery.name: nonce
AttestationNonceQuery.description: A fresh, canonical, unpadded base64url-encoded 32-byte nonce (43 characters). One nonce is single-use. Supply this parameter or the `X-Attestation-Nonce` header, never both. The endpoint fails with `nonce_required` when neither is present (services/gateway/ATTESTATION.md; services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `attestation_response`).

AttestationNonceHeader.name: X-Attestation-Nonce
AttestationNonceHeader.description: An alternative to the `nonce` query parameter. Supply at most one occurrence, and only one of the query parameter or this header, never both.

tool_call_id.description: Present on a `tool` role message: the id of the `ToolCall` this message answers.

Tool.description: An `OpenAI`-compatible function tool the caller offers the model. Passed through to the upstream unchanged (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `proxy_inference`); production runs sglang with `--tool-call-parser=deepseekv4`.

parameters.description: A JSON Schema object describing the function's arguments.

arguments.description: A JSON-encoded string of the function call arguments.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: The gateway itself requires only `model` (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `proxy_inference`). The upstream sglang-router enforces the full OpenAI chat-completions contract, including a `messages` array. `tools` and `tool_choice` pass through to the upstream unchanged.

model.description: Must equal the one model the deployment authorizes for inference. GET /v1/models may list additional catalog entries that are not accepted here.

tool_choice.description: "auto", "none", "required", or an object naming one required tool.

CompletionRequest.description: The gateway itself requires only `model`. The upstream enforces the full OpenAI legacy-completions contract, including a `prompt`.

reasoning_content.description: The model's reasoning text, split out by the upstream `--reasoning-parser=deepseek-v4` flag. Present only when the request asked for reasoning (`chat_template_kwargs.thinking: true`).

items.description: A streamed tool-call delta: `index` selects the tool call being built; `id` and `function.name` normally arrive on the first delta for that index, with `function.arguments` streamed incrementally afterward.

ChatCompletionChunkStream.description:
A `text/event-stream` body. Each event is `data: <ChatCompletionChunk JSON>

`. The stream ends with a literal `data: [DONE]

` event. When the request sets `stream_options.include_usage: true`, one final chunk carries an empty `choices` array and a populated `usage` object.

CompletionChunkStream.description: A `text/event-stream` body carrying `text_completion`-shaped events, ending with a literal `data: [DONE]\n\n` event.

completion_tokens_details.description: Present when the upstream reports a token breakdown for the completion, including reasoning tokens split out by `--reasoning-parser=deepseek-v4`.

GatewayError.description: The exact shape the gateway itself emits for a synthesized error (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `client_error`; services/gateway/src/protection.rs, `error`). This differs from the four-field OpenAI error shape: the gateway sets only `code` and `message`. When the upstream sglang-router itself returns a non-2xx status, the gateway streams that response body through unchanged, in whatever shape the upstream used.

InvalidJson.description: The body is not valid JSON (`invalid_json`), or `model` is missing (`model_required`), or `model` does not name the one authorized inference model (`model_not_authorized`, also returned with status 401).

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, malformed, unknown, revoked (`invalid_api_key`), or names an unauthorized model (`model_not_authorized`).

RequestBodyTimeout.description: Reading the request body exceeded the body timeout (10 seconds by default; `GATEWAY_BODY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`).

RequestTooLarge.description: The request body exceeded the maximum body size (2097152 bytes by default; `GATEWAY_MAXIMUM_BODY_BYTES`).

InferenceCapacity.description: The gateway rejected the request because a concurrency, queue, or per-key limit was full (`inference_capacity`), or because the gateway state store is unavailable and the gateway runs in outage-only mode (`gateway_state_unavailable`, `Retry-After: 30`).

UpstreamUnavailable.description: The gateway could not reach the sglang-router upstream.

AttestationOk.description: One raw c8s evidence response, bound to the supplied nonce. The gateway sets `Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0`. This response proves launch or admission only; it does not prove liveness. The full shape is contracts/workload-attestation.schema.json.

AttestationBadNonce.description: The caller supplied the nonce in both places (`ambiguous_nonce`), supplied no nonce (`nonce_required`), or supplied a nonce that fails the 43-character canonical unpadded base64url check (`invalid_nonce`).

AttestationNonceRejected.description: The nonce was already used, or the nonce store is at capacity (`nonce_rejected`). A nonce is single-use only after a successful response; a failed attestation releases the nonce for reuse (services/gateway/src/lib.rs, `release_failed_nonce`).

AttestationCapacity.description: The attestation concurrency limit is full (4 concurrent requests by default; `GATEWAY_ATTESTATION_CONCURRENCY`).

AttestationInvalid.description: The c8s evidence collector returned evidence that failed the gateway's own shape checks.

AttestationUnavailable.description: The c8s evidence collector was unreachable or timed out.
